bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
# Non-secret presence check: no credential values, file contents, or paths printed.
mask=0
if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q 'gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1'; then mask=$((mask+1)); fi
if docker inspect gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f1 | grep -Eq '^(TELEGRAM_API_ID|TG_API_ID|API_ID)$'; then mask=$((mask+2)); fi
if docker inspect gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f1 | grep -Eq '^(TELEGRAM_API_HASH|TG_API_HASH|API_HASH)$'; then mask=$((mask+4)); fi
if find /home/gace/Project/Gserver /home/gace -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -name '.env' -o -name '.env.*' -o -name '*telegram*api*.env' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 300 | xargs -r grep -El '(^|[[:space:]])(TELEGRAM_API_ID|TG_API_ID|API_ID)=' 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then mask=$((mask+8)); fi
if find /home/gace/Project/Gserver /home/gace -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -name '.env' -o -name '.env.*' -o -name '*telegram*api*.env' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 300 | xargs -r grep -El '(^|[[:space:]])(TELEGRAM_API_HASH|TG_API_HASH|API_HASH)=' 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then mask=$((mask+16)); fi
if curl -sSf --max-time 2 'http://127.0.0.1:8081/' >/dev/null 2>&1; then mask=$((mask+32)); fi
exit $((100+mask))
